diagnosis: The SMS campaign testing endpoint allows users to trigger template dispatches via an internal client that holds privileged machine credentials. The internal service executes the send under the sender profile of whatever templateId is specified. Because the calling endpoint does not verify that templateId belongs to the caller's organization, any tenant can send SMS messages using custom alpha-numeric sender IDs and SMS credits of another organization.
exploit_request:
POST /api/campaigns/send-test HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.acmemarketing.com:8083
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json
